title: Percussion techniques
description: Strokes, surfaces and modifiers through the unpitched percussion bridge, each from Dorico's own items: snare noteheads (side stick, rim shot, cross stick), rim, stick shot, buzz roll and snares off/on; hi-hat open, closed and half-open; cymbal choke, l.v. and damp; a tambourine trill; conga open and muffled. Most marks are added by hand in Dorico (the list appears when the test is armed; the score shows an "add:" cue at each).
